Edit: Gaming purposes (from esports games to flight/car sim games lol) with video and photo editing use
[donnot] I bought a couple of the Q27G40E's and am super happy with them - 180Hz and G-Sync certified. Also has 127% sRGB (99% on the Dell) and 102% DCI-P3. Contrast is higher on the Dell though.
[Doy] Highly recommend this. Paired with a 3070 GPU at 1440P, and it's running nicely at 144fps and Freesync (G-Sync). Response time feels totally smooth. The IPS panel actually looks really good, not noticing much significant glow. I think it's as good as many other gaming monitors, but since Dell haven't marketed that way it enjoys a lower price tag. Without going into OLEDs or 4K, this is pretty amazing value at its price for gamers. Enjoy a nice cup of cold soy milk in these coming warm months.
[Grok] I bought one of these when they were cheaper
Fantastic monitor, very happy with it. Bought it as a stopgap to a 32inch 4K but now I won’t bother. It’s plenty big enough, the resolution is great for the size. I like everything about it.
OK the stand is very basic, no height adjustment
[railspider] Bought one of these in the last deal, obviously an unbeatable monitor at the price. One minor complaint is I own an older model Dell 27" QHD and find it has better colour reproduction than this panel.
